title: Add RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples + docs site updates
author: Samira Patel
description:
Summary: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and supporting docs-site updates. These changes provide opinionated templates for common RAG workflows (document search + tool usage), sample agent implementations that demonstrate function/tool calling patterns, and updated docs site pages and navigation so users can discover quickstarts from the getting-started and agents sections.

Motivation: We want to make it easier for developers to bootstrap RAG-based agents that use Redwood tool-calling and the new agent SDK surfaces. This PR captures recommended templates, example code, and docs that reduce time-to-first-success for product teams.

What changed (high level): - New quickstart templates under redwood-examples/agent-quickstarts/rag-tool-calling - Example integrations showing: local vector store + RAG agent, cloud docs + tool-calling, and a small web demo for interactive testing - Docs site updates: navigation entry, quickstart pages, code snippets and screenshots, and a migration note for older agent examples - Unit/integration test updates for examples (small test harness)

Checklist: - [x] Add quickstart templates and starter README - [x] Write docs site pages and add navigation - [x] Add example tests and CI job - [x] Address reviewer feedback and accessibility issues - [x] Update changelog / release notes

Testing notes: Examples are covered by a lightweight integration test that runs in the examples CI matrix (node/python runners). Docs site built locally and verified against the staging site. CI initially reported a flaky example test which was retriggered and passed on the second run.

Related: Linear ENG-4782 (RAG quickstarts), ENG-4810 (agent tool-calling examples), SUP-922 (support ticket requesting clearer docs for tool calling).
commits: Initial scaffold of rag agent quickstarts and templates
Add tool-calling example (python + ts wrappers) and integration tests
Docs site pages, nav updates, screenshots, and small copy edits
review_comments: Ethan Liu: Can you add a note about required vector store capacities for the local example? The current README doesn't mention indexing limits.
Samira Patel: Good point - added a subsection to the quickstart README that lists sample dataset sizes and recommended settings.
Priya Nair: The TS example throws a lint warning about any types; can we tighten typings?
Samira Patel: Updated the TS example to use stricter types and ran the linter locally; ci shows lint passing now.
Carlos Gomez: Please ensure docs site nav follows the existing pattern and that headings are H2/H3 accessible structure.
Samira Patel: Adjusted headings to match site conventions and added alt text to screenshots.
Priya Nair: One of the example integration tests flaked in CI previously - was that addressed?
Samira Patel: That test was non-deterministic because it relied on external embeddings rate limits; I swapped to a local mock embeddings provider in the test harness. CI re-ran and passed.
merge_outcome: merged (squash and merge) - squashed into single commit with summary 'add: rag agent quickstarts + tool-calling examples + docs update'
release_notes:
- Added: RAG agent quickstarts demonstrating tool-calling patterns (Python + TypeScript)
- Added: docs site pages and navigation for agent quickstarts
- Added: example integration tests and CI job to prevent regressions
- Notes: Examples use a local mock embeddings provider in CI to avoid flakiness; production examples show cloud provider integrations.
notes_for_oncall: No runtime changes in production. If examples CI starts failing after upstream dependency updates, the flaky test harness uses a mock and may require update. See ENG-4782 for follow-ups.
security_considerations: Docs and examples do not include secrets. The quickstarts explicitly call out KMS/HSM usage for private deployments in a dedicated security subsection.
notes: This is a medium-sized docs+examples PR intended to reduce onboarding time for new users evaluating RAG agent tool-calling workflows. Follow-up work: add an additional example showing multi-tool orchestration and a sandbox script for on-prem demos.
